verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a design tool with a cloud Workspace and web app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a locally installed Mac app, a local-only MCP server and an open .sketch file format, but nothing documents running the Sketch Workspace or web app on your own infrastructure. A local desktop install and a perpetual offline license are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
